thesis: AI liquid cooling is the current earnings-growth engine; humanoid-robot liquid cooling is a credible but currently immaterial option. The stock requires sustained high earnings growth and better cash conversion to justify the present multiple.
entry_or_start_small_conditions: Approx. CNY35 or lower while AI liquid-cooling demand, delivery and earnings thesis remain intact.
OR materially stronger AI-liquid-cooling revenue/margin/cash-conversion evidence at a higher price, sufficient to raise a credible 2028 base earnings path above about CNY1.0-1.1bn.
Correlated AI/liquid-cooling portfolio exposure remains acceptable.
add_conditions: AI liquid-cooling revenue/proxy materially outgrows group revenue.
Thermal-management gross margin improves with higher liquid-cooling mix.
Rolling CFO/net-profit conversion normalizes above roughly 1x or working-capital build visibly converts into sales and cash.
Higher-content system products become repeat batch revenue.
kill_criteria: Two or more quarters of material AI-server/liquid-cooling order deterioration without credible cyclical explanation.
Thermal-management revenue grows but gross margin structurally declines.
Persistent CFO weakness with rising receivables/inventory/debt despite reported profit growth.
Material key-customer loss or repeated failure to convert sample/pilot programs to batch orders.
Broad hyperscaler real-compute capex cuts combined with weaker GPU/rack deployment.
Robot narrative becomes a major valuation pillar while robot revenue remains immaterial.
notes: This is a research decision, not an order. WATCH maps to zero default capital under current TRQuant capital rules; any starter requires explicit review.
